title: Three Young Children on Suburban Lawn, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sunny mid-1940s outdoor black-and-white snapshot depicting three young children standing together on a lush grassy front yard. In the center, a slightly older girl with curly hair wears a light-colored collared day dress. To her left stands a young boy in a belted short-sleeve shirt and shorts, while a younger blond boy in light-colored overalls stands to her right holding a small toy or snack. In the residential background, suburban houses, a palm tree, and late-1930s to 1940s sedans parked along the street are visible, evoking postwar American suburban life. A partial figure enters the right edge of the frame.
